Slide.Title: jail (noun)

Slide.Title: job (noun)

Slide.Title: join (verb)

Slide.Title: joint (noun)
Slide.SlideText: joint (noun) Definition: Definition: a part of the body where bones are connected, for example the knee or elbow Synonyms: Synonyms: Examples: Examples: 1) The knee is the body’s largest joint. 2) In cold weather, her joints become swollen. 3) Arthritis is a painful condition that affects the joints. Slide.Title: joint (adjective)
Slide.SlideText: joint (adjective) Definition: Definition: shared by two or more Synonyms: Synonyms: shared, communal, common Examples: Examples: They made a joint decision to divorce. Slide.Title: joke (verb)

Slide.SlideText: joke (noun) Definition: Definition: something done or said to cause others to laugh Synonyms: Synonyms: quip, humor Examples: Examples: I love jokes about animals. Slide.Title: judge (verb)
Slide.SlideText: judge (verb) Definition: Definition: to form an opinion about Synonyms: Synonyms: evaluate, criticize Examples: Examples: I try not to judge my friends’ decisions. Slide.Title: judge (noun)
Slide.SlideText: judge (noun) Definition: Definition: a public official who decides problems in a court or winners in a competition Synonyms: Synonyms: arbiter, justice Examples: Examples: Many people disagreed with the judge’s decision. Slide.Title: jump (verb)
Slide.SlideText: jump (verb) Definition: Definition: to push down on the feet and move up quickly into the air Synonyms: Synonyms: leap, hop, bounce Examples: Examples: The dog jumped up and caught the ball. Slide.Title: jury (noun)
Slide.SlideText: jury (noun) Definition: Definition: a group of people chosen to decide what is true in a trial Synonyms: Synonyms: tribunal, panel Examples: Examples: Juries usually have 12 members. Slide.Title: just (adverb)
Slide.SlideText: just (adverb) Definition: Definition: 1) only; 2) very shortly before the present Synonyms: Synonyms: 1) merely, but; 2) recently, barely Examples: Examples: Can you help me for just a minute? Slide.Title: just (adjective)
Slide.SlideText: just (adjective) Definition: Definition: what is right or fair Synonyms: Synonyms: right, honorable, honest Examples: Examples: The anti-smoking law is just, in my opinion.
